name: The Shores
bio: The Shores is a neighborhood bar and restaurant in Oxnard Shores, a few blocks from the beach on Harbor Boulevard. It hosts local bands, acoustic sets and DJs, plus karaoke on Thursday nights.
bio_source: Written by TOPA from theshoresoxnard.com and @theshoresoxnard.
source: public web search, the venue's website and public Instagram, and US Census address lookup, 2026-10-29
